title: A Memory of Oils
name: A Memory of Oils
desc: A treatise explaining the usage of various weapon oils
intro: Spoken in a wavering, ancient voice, this memory note contains the ramblings of an ancient Giant-king on the various oils developed and used by the slaves of the arena.

title: Absinthe
name: Absinthe
desc: Powerful liquor of a mystically green hue
intro: A powerful drink, often said to taste like a mixture of dessert and a death god's tears, absinthe is often mixed with water and sugar. Poets, artists, and mad revelers of the most decadent disposition swear by this green drink's reputed powers to cause visions and reveling bedlam. The Mad King of Ophir, Moranthes II, is said drink the stuff with every meal. Absinthe heavily heats the tongue.

title: Abysmal Flesh
name: Abysmal Flesh
desc: Flesh harvested from the Abysmal Remnant
intro: This foul-smelling, acidic meat does not look or smell appetizing.

title: Ale
name: Ale
desc: A most refreshing beverage
intro: One of the oldest forms of alcoholic drink devised by man. With just enough alcohol to preserve it, ale can save lives when water is tainted or in short supply. It cools and refreshes.

title: Aloe Extract
name: Aloe Extract
desc: Extract of the aloe plant
intro: Stygian traditions of healing hold that the aloe plant contains many desirable properties. In Luxur, the aloe is harvested for use in the temples of Derketo to cleanse blemishes from the skin of the priestesses. It is often used to sooth oozing wounds and those who ingest it claim that they feel a burst of wellbeing. Whether these effects are of the body or the mind is irrelevant - ingesting aloe

title: Aloe Soup
name: Aloe Soup
desc: A green soup with no meat at all
intro: Many a survivor knows to apply the juice of the aloe to a burn or to seek the plant's moisture when trekking out in the hot wastes, but certain crones and culinary masters know the healing properties of cooking aloe in a soup. Such a meal offers seemingly instant and moderate relief to the injured.

name: Ambrosia
desc: A dish purported to be blessed by the gods
effect: Health +40, Mitra's Blessing, Sated, Strength Weapon Damage +10%
intro: Worshippers of Mitra often bring sacrifices of fruit or grain to lay upon his altar, in return for his blessing. And occasionally his blessing is very formidable indeed, taking the form of Ambrosia. name: Ancient Rhino Horn
desc: The horn of an ancient rhinoceros
intro: There is a certain energy in the fall of an ancient beast. This horn, taken from an ancient rhinocerous, is an occult focal point. Who knows to what use such an artefact could be put?

title: Anglerfish

title: Antidote
name: Antidote
desc: A potent antidote to poison
intro: A general purpose antidote created to purge poisons from the blood and body. Such an item shouldn't exist and certainly not one synthesized in the manner that this is. The Isle of Siptah is truly a miraculous place...

title: Arena Ritual Offering

intro: Thousands of years past, when the Giant-kings ruled the land and the arena was active, there was a human gladiator named Tyros.

title: Argossean Dream Dust

intro: The process of making Argossean Dream Dust is a secret kept by the Black Hand that they do not share willingly. Not that many would be interested in it anyway, given the side-effects. One cannot deny it's usefulness though.

title: Bag of Assorted Venoms
name: Bag of Assorted Venoms
desc: A container that, when used, confers a random number of poisons and venoms.
intro: Less a bag than a small pouch containing an odd assortment of deadly ingredients. Highly prized by Vindhyan murder cults and conniving pirate captains everywhere.

title: Bag of Essences
name: Bag of Essences
desc: A container that, when used, confers a random number of Essences.
intro: A roughly stitched sack of indeterminate origin. The bag's crude appearance conceals both a wondrous cargo and its own blasphemous origins in ghost haunted vaults of Stygia.

title: Berry Juice
name: Berry Juice
desc: Sweet drink made from berries
intro: This drink, made from squeezed berries, is sweet to the taste and lightly cools the parched tongue.

title: Berserker Draught
name: Berserker Draught
desc: A potion that incites rage and strength
intro: Drinking this potion will make the imbiber fly into a berserk frenzy, increasing damage and armor but prevent healing. Once the effects of the potion wears off, the imbiber becomes fatigued.

title: Bitter Tea
name: Bitter Tea
desc: A bitter tea that increases stamina
intro: Strong tea, steeped with potent spices, can drastically refresh one's stamina while heating the body and mind. Turanian guards who draw the late shift are said to be quite fond of this drink on cold, desert nights.

title: Black Lotus Potion
name: Black Lotus Potion
desc: Brewed from the deadly petals of the black lotus
effect: Drunken, Gaining Corruption, Poisoned, Strength Weapon Damage +15%
intro: The black lotus is a much feared, oft-discussed, plant. It is said that the scent of the flowers brings mad, blighted dreams that trouble all but the blackest of souls. The juice of the black lotus is death, an instant plunge into darkness from which one can never recover.

title: Blackcove Rum
name: Blackcove Rum
desc: Aclohol. Alloco... Alocolol... it's booze.
intro: This will get you good and drunk and make you speak like a pirate.

title: Blood Sausage
name: Blood Sausage
desc: Links of meat held together by innards. Tasty.
intro: Loved by some, hated by most - blood sausages are a staple food amongst the tribes of the frozen north. Every part of the animal is used, even the blood that courses through their veins.

title: Blood-Sac
name: Blood-Sac
desc: A harvested blood sac
intro: A strange blood producing organ with no equivalent in the anatomy of man. When used, the blood sac confers a random number of monstrous body fluids.

title: Blood-stained Nails
name: Blood-stained Nails
desc: A manuscript written by the Archivist himself
intro: This book describes the life and work-conditions of a barbarian that suffers from fear of blood. Most of the book is dedicated to the barbarian trying to clean his nails. The story feels... wrong. But it is strangely inspiring when read. If written by another author, it could have been a very good read.

title: Bone Broth
name: Bone Broth
desc: Under the delicious broth is something that was recently...human
intro: A delicacy out of Darfar. The proper way to serve this delicious, hot broth is with a hull human skull in the bowl, slowly revealed with every slurping spoonful.

title: Bread
name: Bread
desc: A loaf of bread
intro: Bread takes on many forms, baked from various mixtures of dough and water. On the climb from savagery, bread tends to come at the dawn of agriculture.

title: Breath of Dagon
name: Breath of Dagon
desc: A potion that gives the ability to breathe underwater
intro: This potion, made from crushed scales, allows the imbiber to breathe underwater for a prolongued period of time. The potion is sickeningly sweet and smells like rotting fish, but is effective.

title: Breathing Potion
name: Breathing Potion
desc: A glowing potion that improves underwater breathing
intro: The Dregs have always been a dangerous place. When the Giant-kings would send slaves to clean out the sewers, they would often lose valuable servants to the creatures which dwelt in the sewers, not to mention those that drowned when a chamber suddenly flooded.

title: Bug Kabob
name: Bug Kabob
desc: Roasted bugs on a skewer
intro: A trick learned from the people of Kush is to skewer assortments of large insects and grubs, with bits of vegetable or fruit for flavor, and roast it all on a fire. It makes for a surprisingly tasty treat.

title: Burlap Satchel
name: Burlap Satchel
desc: A rough spun satchel dropped by a sorcerer
intro: The satchel is often the sorcerer's most guarded possession, a container of important lore only relinquished when pried from their cold, dead hands. It can contain a Sorcerous Spell page, reagents used for casting, or other relevant sorcery items.

title: Bush Jerky
name: Bush Jerky
desc: Strips of feral meat dried and salted
intro: Meat can be preserved for a time by salting and drying. The process also improves the flavor, or perhaps covers it up, of stringy and gamy meat.

title: Cactus Wine
name: Cactus Wine
desc: An unlikely drink, sweeter than expected
intro: Humankind will find a way to have its drink, and there are those who learned to make an alcoholic beverage where grapes fear to grow. Made from the fermented juice of the cactus, this wine cools the tongue.

title: Catfish

title: Century Egg
name: Century Egg
desc: Dark green egg smelling of ammonia
intro: There is a method of preserving eggs, developed in faraway Khitai. The details vary among the people, but this method often involves clay or ash or salt or quicklime. The egg, so preserved, turns to a dark green. Those foreign to the practice often only eat such an egg out of desperation or a drunken dare. There is the chance that the one who preserved it did not use the ancient method precisely.

title: Chili Desert Style
name: Chili Desert Style
desc: Meaty and eye-wateringly spiced
intro: A specialty of desert caravans. Whatever meat is available is mixed and stewed and livened with copious amounts of spice. This dish will heavily heat the pallet.

title: Cimmerian Feast
name: Cimmerian Feast
desc: It's hot, and its filling
intro: The Cimmerians are a hearty people, and they make their meals equally hearty when they can afford to. But Cimmerians are also a grim people, and things such as spice and flavor rarely touch their tongues.

title: Cimmerian book of Taunts
name: Cimmerian book of Taunts
desc: A message in a bottle
intro: This note mostly contains a litany of swear-words and crude drawings of gestures. Reading it will teach you a number of taunts.

title: Cleansing Brew
name: Cleansing Brew
desc: Smells sharp
intro: It is said that the long-dead sage Epemitreus devised a modest brew, by steeping a very particular mix of herbs and ingredients in boiling water, that could cleanse a small amount of the corrupting influence of the Outer Dark from one's mind and body.

intro: The tribes of Darfar know how to find hidden sustenance. Certain grubs and meaty insects, combined with certain herbs, make for a surprisingly refreshing soup. Served cold, this dish moderately cools the pallet.

title: Dead Sorcerer's Map (Variant A)
name: Dead Sorcerer's Map
desc: The hand-drawn map of a dead sorcerer
intro: This folded and cracked map is drawn with a skillful hand and details what appears to be a long-forgotten cave network. What lies at the end of the map's prescribed trail is marked only with an arcane symbol.

desc: A sealed leather skin for storing water
intro: Pitch has been used to seal this waterskin, slowing the inevitable leaks and keeping the water level stable. The addition of pitch, however, adds a nasty sulphurous aftertaste to the water.

title: Demon Blood-Sausage
name: Demon Blood-Sausage
desc: Links of blackened meat
intro: The blood and flesh of demons are not only components to the profane rituals of sorcerers... but also the culinary arts of the adventurous. These links of cooked meat seem to pulse with eldritch life and eating such fare bestows strong recuperative powers, over time, to the eater.

title: Denizens of the Dark Well
name: Denizens of the Dark Well
desc: A manuscript written by the Archivist himself
intro: This book describes the adventures of a barbarian and his encounter with a dark well, which he is too afraid to jump down into as he hears whispering voices from it. The story feels... wrong. But it is strangely inspiring when read. If written by another author, it could have been a very good read.

title: Desert Berries
name: Desert Berries
desc: Small, blue berries
intro: Growing in the dry wastes of the desert, these berries are used in the making of juice and wine. They can be eaten, though they do not offer much nourishment. Still, any sustenance is precious out in the desolate lands.

title: Desert Berry Pulp
name: Desert Berry Pulp
desc: Blue berry pulp
intro: This blue-colored pulp, squeezed from desert berries, can be used to make wine.

title: Desert Grog
name: Desert Grog
desc: A strong, alcoholic beverage
effect: Agility Weapon Damage +15%, Cooling Down, Drunken
intro: Only Vald himself knows what this drink contains but whatever it is it smells of old socks and distilled alcohol.

title: Desert Rum
name: Desert Rum
desc: A strong, alcoholic beverage
intro: Only Vald himself knows what this drink contains but whatever it is it smells of old socks and distilled alcohol.

title: Desert Wine
name: Desert Wine
desc: A particularly thirst-quenching wine
intro: A light-colored wine, popular in Turan, known to ease a throat that has taken in the dust of the desert roads. It cools the tongue more than the average vintage.

title: Devil's Bonemeal
name: Devil's Bonemeal
desc: The crushed bones and marrow of an otherworldly creature.
intro: Taken from a dark creature summoned from the outer void, this ground up hunk of disgusting matter glows with an otherworldy energy.

title: Dogfish
name: Dogfish
desc: A rare fish
intro: Raw meat is a dangerous temptation for the starving and desperate. Consuming it provides immediate relief from hunger - but at the risk of inheriting any disease or parasite that may have come along for the ride.

title: Draught of Slow Fall
name: Draught of Slow Fall
desc: This brew grants the drinker temporary Slow Fall.
intro: This potion allows the quaffer to conjure gusts of air to slow descent and make it safe to fall from any height.

title: Draught of the Dead
name: Draught of the Dead
desc: This brew grants the drinker the temporary ability to perform Call of the Dead.
intro: This potion allows the quaffer to call forth a terrible fog and the vile undead that stir within its dusky volume. Should any undead leave the area of fog, they will turn to dust.

title: Dried Berries
name: Dried Berries
desc: A handful of dried berries
intro: These berries have been dried to preserve them. They do not offer much nourishment, but will resist decay for a time.

title: Dried Fish
name: Dried Fish
desc: Preserved fish flesh
intro: Salting and drying are among man's earliest means of preserving food. This fish flesh will resist decay for a while.

title: Dried Meat
name: Dried Meat
desc: Preserved animal flesh
intro: Salting and drying are among man's earliest means of preserving food. This animal flesh will resist decay for a while.

title: Dye Pack
name: Dye Pack
desc: A bag full of dyes
intro: This bag contains an assortment of dyes.

title: Egg
name: Egg
desc: A large nutritious meal
intro: Many eggs, amongst others the Shaleback eggs, are considered a rare delicacy in the civilized lands. Anybody who has seen an enraged adult Shaleback up close can understand why they remain so.

title: Egg Surprise
name: Egg Surprise
desc: A delicious looking egg...
intro: These innocent-looking eggs hide a gleeful treachery. Within the obfuscation of the shell there resides a blasphemous gush of ichor. Some sadistic nobles relish springing such a surprise on their guests, savoring the looks on their masticating faces.

title: Eight-Sided Die
name: Eight-Sided Die
desc: A die shaped from bones
intro: A favored pass-time by many adventurers is playing dice. With taverns being few and far apart in the Exiled lands, one has to make do with what one can.

title: Eighty Shades of Pink
name: Eighty Shades of Pink
desc: A message in a bottle
intro: This note contain extracts from what seems to be an erotic novella called 'Eighty Shades of Pink'. Reading it will teach you how to engage with others before, while, and after bedding them.

title: Eldarium Cache
name: Eldarium Cache
desc: A container that, when used, confers a random amount of Eldarium.
intro: This rough-spun parcel of white sailcloth holds a small but precious cache of highly-prized Eldarium pieces.

title: Elixir of Darkness
name: Elixir of Darkness
desc: This brew grants the drinker the temporary ability to channel pure Darkness.
intro: This potion allows the quaffer to channel pure darkness to surround their being. Utilize the darkness to ambush unsuspecting targets or evade prey.

title: Elixir of Enduring
name: Elixir of Enduring
desc: This brew grants the drinker increased armor.
intro: This potion provides the quaffer with a temporary boost to grit and the absolute certainty that they can succeed at any endeavor.

title: Elixir of Freedom
name: Elixir of Freedom
desc: A concoction that frees the imbiber
intro: The priests and priestesses of Derketo have often had to deal with penitents who were too reserved or too unwilling to participate in the orgiastic ceremonies of the goddess.

title: Elixir of Grace
name: Elixir of Grace
desc: This brew grants the drinker improved agility.
intro: This potion provides the quaffer with a temporary improvement to agility, making them more graceful, seemingly able to dance among the attacks of their enemies.

title: Elixir of Might
name: Elixir of Might
desc: This brew grants the drinker increased strength.
intro: This potion provides the quaffer with a temporary boost to strength. For a limited period of time, they can perform feats of immense strength proportionate to their original strength, of course.

title: Elixir of Numbing
name: Elixir of Numbing
desc: This brew grants the drinker increased carrying capacity.
intro: This potion provides the quaffer with a temporary boost to carrying capacity and is often given to slaves to improve their ability to bear excedingly heavy loads.

title: Elixir of Rebirth
name: Elixir of Rebirth
desc: A potion that randomly rerolls the learned perk of a thrall.
intro: Training thralls is a time-intensive and laborious task that often results in failure. But the clever transmuter knows that the best solutions are the kind you mix on an alchemist's bench. This potion confers a random number of learned perks upon your thrall.

title: Elixir of Sight
name: Elixir of Sight
desc: This brew grants the drinker improved concussive damage output.
intro: This potion provides the quaffer with a temporary boost to eyesight and accuracy - useful for knocking out foes.

title: Elixir of Vigor
name: Elixir of Vigor
desc: This brew grants the drinker improved survivability.
intro: This potion provides the quaffer with a feeling of robust health. Wounds seem to matter less under the influence of this potion, which is either a blessing or a curse depending on the situation.

title: Enhanced Gruel
name: Enhanced Gruel
desc: It is gruel, but it actually smells good
intro: Sometimes one is able to find a few extra things to throw into the gruel, to make it a more satisfying meal.

title: Everice of Ymir
name: Everice of Ymir
desc: A fragment of ice that echoes with strange knowledge
intro: This icicle radiates a cold so intense that it almost burns the flesh to touch it. Icicles such as this are said to be fragments of ice shaken from the beard of Ymir as he takes vengeance upon his enemies. They never melt, but lie where they are fallen until they are discovered by shamans, who undertake vision quests to discover them.

title: Exotic Feast
name: Exotic Feast
desc: A decadent display of choice meats
effect: Sated, Strength Weapon Damage +15%, Warming Up
intro: Some eat merely to survive another savage day. Others, of a sensual bent, create magnificent feasts of the most exotic meats, feasts that would make the gods salivate unto a deluge. Decadence to the point of madness? Perhaps. But there is something to be said for the great boon of health this grants the eater.

title: Exotic Fish
name: Exotic Fish
desc: Raw flesh harvested from exotic fish
intro: Raw meat is a dangerous temptation for the starving and desperate. Consuming it provides immediate relief from hunger - but at the risk of inheriting any disease or parasite that may have come along for the ride.

title: Exotic Flesh
name: Exotic Flesh
desc: Raw flesh harvested from exotic animals
intro: Raw meat is a dangerous temptation for the starving and desperate. Consuming it provides immediate relief from hunger but at the risk of inheriting any disease or parasite that may have come along for the ride.

title: Exotic Shellfish
name: Exotic Shellfish
desc: Raw flesh harvested from exotic shellfish
intro: Raw meat is a dangerous temptation for the starving and desperate. Consuming it provides immediate relief from hunger - but at the risk of inheriting any disease or parasite that may have come along for the ride.

title: Exquisite Meat
name: Exquisite Meat
desc: A choice cut
intro: Raw meat is a dangerous temptation for the starving and desperate. Consuming it provides immediate relief from hunger - but at the risk of inheriting any disease or parasite that may have come along for the ride.

title: Exquisite Stew
name: Exquisite Stew
desc: Chunks of exotic meat floating in a fine stew
intro: Only the choicest cuts of meat go into this superior stew.

title: Eye of Set
name: Eye of Set
desc: A glittering gem that mesmerizes those who stare too deeply
intro: This gem, and others like it, were once used by Priests of Set in their most sacred rituals. It is gravest heresy to discuss such rites, but they involved serpents, sacrifices and blood.

title: Eyes of Innocence
name: Eyes of Innocence
desc: Eyes taken from a being of pure innocence
intro: It is said that all beings are born with light eyes, that darken when the world begins to stain them. These eyes, taken from a creature too young to know the evils of the world, contain a certain amount of power that can be called upon in occult rituals.

title: Eyes of the Demon
name: Eyes of the Demon
desc: The harvested eyes of a Demon that, when used, confers a new character creation option: Red eyes.
intro: Since man first stepped from the forest primeval, numerous cultures have upheld the tradition of gaining potency from vanquished foes through the ritual consumption of their blood or body parts.

title: Eyes of the Wight
name: Eyes of the Wight
desc: The harvested eyes of a Wight that, when used, confers a new character creation option: White eyes.
intro: Since man first stepped from the forest primeval, numerous cultures have upheld the tradition of gaining potency from vanquished foes through the ritual consumption of their blood or body parts.

title: Fat Grub
name: Fat Grub
desc: Disgusting, yet filling
intro: For the strong of stomach, these grubs offer a both food and moisture in the midst of the desert

title: Feast of Derketo
name: Feast of Derketo
desc: A holy food served at the orgies of Derketo
intro: The rituals of Derketo are often mocked by outsiders who do not understand the pleasures and lusts of the goddess. This feast, however, typifies the food served at the revels and orgies of the goddess. No rich or fatty foods here, no. This meal is designed to titillate and preserve the participants, awakening the tingling warmth of the goddess inside them and giving them the stamina to proceed thr

title: Feast of Jhebbal Sag
name: Feast of Jhebbal Sag
desc: A ritualistic meal in honor of Jhebbal Sag
intro: In honor of the god who hunts, lord of beasts and claws and fangs, this meal is prepared to sate even the most hungry predator.

title: Feast of Mitra
name: Feast of Mitra
desc: A ritualistic meal in honor of Mitra
intro: This feast is consumed in the name of Mitra. Mitra, chief god of Hyboria! Mitra, the righteous, the father of justice, the enemy of Set! May this meal open a holy and eternal spring in the belly. May man's heart know mercy. Mitra, guard us against the powers of darkness.

title: Feast of Set
name: Feast of Set
desc: A ritualistic meal in honor of Set
intro: This feast is consumed in the name of Set. Set, the Old Serpent! Set. Archenemy Iblis! Set, who is known as Damballah in the Southern kingdoms, whose holy scales blind all with their bright darkness! Set is a jealous god and requires constant sacrifices from his chosen. This meal is devoured as an offering to the Lord of Snakes. May it grow a nest of serpents in the belly of the eater.

title: Feast of Ymir
name: Feast of Ymir
desc: A ritualistic meal in honor of Ymir
intro: This feast is consumed in the name of Ymir. Ymir, the Frost Giant and father of all lesser giants! Ymir, Lord of Storm and War! May he grant the strength to fight all of the day and drink all of the night. May this meal grant a warrior the bravery to die in battle, earning a place in Ymir's hall in Valhalla to feast and revel until the end of days.

title: Feast to Yog
name: Feast to Yog
desc: A ritualistic meal in honor of Yog
intro: This feast is consumed in the name of Yog. Yog, the Lorde of Empty Abodes! Yog, cousin of them that slither in the immaculate slime of the Elder Night! All good and fearing worshipers of Yog must dedicate themselves to the consumption of only meat. All the faithful of Yog must taste human flesh once a month, lest they become unclean until they again perform this communion of body and blood.

title: Feral Feast
name: Feral Feast
desc: Mounds of cooked, feral meat
intro: A feast of various gamey meats. What such a meal lacks in quality, it makes up for quantity. Gorging on such fare can satisfy the belly and offer a little relief to the injured.

title: Feral Flesh
name: Feral Flesh
desc: Raw flesh harvested from small beasts and fowl
intro: Raw meat is a dangerous temptation for the starving and desperate. Consuming it provides immediate relief from hunger but at the risk of inheriting any disease or parasite that may have come along for the ride.

title: Fiery-Hot Bread
name: Fiery-Hot Bread
desc: A spiced dish
intro: This dish has an immediate warming effect on whomever eats it.

title: Fiery-Hot Grubs
name: Fiery-Hot Grubs
desc: A spiced dish
intro: This dish has an immediate warming effect on whomever eats it.

title: Fiery-Hot Imperial Tea
name: Fiery-Hot Imperial Tea
desc: Spiced tea
intro: This tea has an immediate warming effect on whomever imbibes it.

title: Fiery-Hot Meat Soup
name: Fiery-Hot Meat Soup
desc: A spiced dish
intro: This dish has an immediate warming effect on whomever eats it.

title: Fiery-Hot Sea-Fish Feast
name: Fiery-Hot Sea-Fish Feast
desc: A spiced dish
intro: This dish has an immediate warming effect on whomever eats it.

title: Firewater
name: Firewater
desc: Tastes like death, but packs a kick
intro: The term is used for too wide an array of strong drinks, of various qualities, often made from whatever is on hand. With any luck, the drinker will spend the night drunk and not wake up blind. It certainly heats the tongue.

title: Fish Gill Potion
name: Fish Gill Potion
desc: A potion that increases underwater breathing time
intro: This potion, made from gently glowing plants, allows the imbiber to spend more time underwater. None are truly sure of how the mechanism works, but it is well known to bandits in Kush, who chew a paste made of the same plants before lying in ambush beneath the waters of rivers that run beside major trade routes.

title: Fish Strips
name: Fish Strips
desc: Cooked strips of fish
intro: Both the savage and the civilized mouth water when strips of meat sizzle and hiss on the skewer.

title: Flavored Gruel
name: Flavored Gruel
desc: Gruel with a dash of flavor
intro: Spices, ingredients, and oddities often get thrown into gruel to mask the fact that all one has to eat is gruel.

title: Flesh Map (Exiled Lands)
name: Flesh Map
desc: A patch of flesh with a map carved into it
intro: A map clutched tightly by any true hunter of Jhebbal Sag, scrawled into a patch of flesh. Hastily scraped and not very well-preserved, it is still somewhat possible to determine the marked location.

title: Flesh Map (Isle of Siptah)
name: Flesh Map
desc: A patch of flesh with a map carved into it
intro: A map clutched tightly by any true hunter of Jhebbal Sag, scrawled into a patch of flesh. Hastily scraped and not very well-preserved, it is still somewhat possible to determine the marked location.

title: Flesh of Remembrance (Variant A)
name: Flesh of Remembrance
desc: Flesh which bears remembrance of Jhebbal Sag
intro: There are very few now who remember Jhebbal Sag and his religions. Primarily in Pictland and the Black Kingdoms is he venerated.

title: Flesh of Remembrance (Variant B)
name: Flesh of Remembrance
desc: Flesh which bears remembrance of Jhebbal Sag
intro: There are very few now who remember Jhebbal Sag and his religions. Primarily in Pictland and the Black Kingdoms is he venerated.

title: Four-Sided Die
name: Four-Sided Die
desc: A die shaped from bones
intro: A favored pass-time by many adventurers is playing dice. With taverns being few and far apart in the Exiled lands, one has to make do with what one can.

title: Fragment of Power
name: Fragment of Power
desc: A stone inscribed with a bizarre symbol
intro: This small piece of stone is inscribed with a symbol that seems to slide away from the eye that beholds it. There is something dark and wonderful about the lines and swirls that make up the shape. This could be offered up to the Archives in order to obtain ancient wisdom.

title: Frenzywine
name: Frenzywine
desc: Incites rage and lowers inhibitions
effect: Berserker's Protection, Berserking, Drunken, Warming Up
intro: This has been called the nectar of the gods by many a Vanir berserker. It is far more often referred to as 'a good reason to not visit Vanaheim', second only to the natives themselves.

title: Frost Lotus Potion
name: Frost Lotus Potion
desc: A potion brewed from the frost lotus
intro: Unlike the other flowers of this family, the frost lotus has no towering reputation for strange mystical effects. It is possible that alchemists have simply not discovered the best possible use of this blossom - further experimentation is the only way to find out.

title: Golden Lotus Potion
name: Golden Lotus Potion
desc: Brewed from golden lotus petals
intro: Known for its healing properties, golden lotus has been rumored to be able to mend broken bones, heal scars and even unnaturally extend the life of those who drink it.

title: Grand Ophidian Magi's Cache
name: Grand Ophidian Magi's Cache
desc: Contains various rewards for your efforts.
intro: This bulky package contains a generous reward that may yield rare coins, alchemical reagents, or shaped golem components.

title: Grey Lotus Potion
name: Grey Lotus Potion
desc: Brewed from the gray lotus plant
intro: The Grey Lotus plant is rumored to grow only in the swamps of the dead, beyond the land of Khitai. A powder made from these plants is known to drive men into a berserker rage, giving them inhuman strength and brutality - and no capacity for mercy.

title: Grilled Steak
name: Grilled Steak
desc: Cooked slab of succulent meat
intro: Juicy with the blood and fat of the kill, this universally life sustaining meal could as easily be found around the campfires of hunters from Vanaheim to the southern Black Kingdoms.

title: Grouper
name: Grouper
desc: A rare fish
intro: Raw meat is a dangerous temptation for the starving and desperate. Consuming it provides immediate relief from hunger - but at the risk of inheriting any disease or parasite that may have come along for the ride.

title: Groveller's Manual
name: Groveller's Manual
desc: A message in a bottle
intro: Whomever wrote this was truly a spineless coward. Reading this will teach you the same skills. Although why you would want to is a mystery.

title: Gruel
name: Gruel
desc: A thin, foul-smelling gruel
intro: Made from plant seeds that have been ground into a paste and mixed with water, this thin and watery gruel is probably not enough to sustain an active adventurer. For thralls, however, it serves.

title: Handful of Insects
name: Handful of Insects
desc: These will keep starvation at bay. Barely.
intro: To the starving, a handful of insects can be enough to stave off hunger for a while.

title: Hanuman's Gift
name: Hanuman's Gift
desc: A boon granted by Hanuman
intro: This multi-colored tincture can be consumed in order to get a random bonus to one attribute.

title: Healing Waterskin
name: Healing Waterskin
desc: A sealed leather skin for storing water
intro: Pitch has been used to seal this waterskin, slowing the inevitable leaks and keeping the water level stable. The addition of pitch, however, adds a nasty sulphurous aftertaste to the water.

title: Healing Wraps
name: Healing Wraps
desc: Bandages used for binding wounds
intro: Wounds require special care, to heal and to avoid infection and putrefaction. Sometimes, upon the battlefield, all one can do is bind a wound with strips of fiber.

title: Heart of a Hero
name: Heart of a Hero
desc: The heart of a fallen hero
intro: This heart was taken from the chest of one who once called themselves a hero. The definition shifts between cultures and locations so being sure that one has captured the heart of a hero is a difficult business. Most sorcerers simply content themselves with trying out hundreds of hearts, in the hope that the odds are on their side.

title: Hearty Feast
name: Hearty Feast
desc: A meal both filling and flavorful
intro: Only the heartiest meals can prepare one for the savage world.

title: Hearty Stew
name: Hearty Stew
desc: Chunks of succulent meat floating in a stew
intro: Meat chopped up and cooked in a broth of vegetables makes for a simmering stew that smells both inviting and filling.

title: Herbal Tea
name: Herbal Tea
desc: A medicinal brew
intro: This brew, a recipe from far away Khitai, revitalizes one's stamina in small measures.

title: Highland Berries
name: Highland Berries
desc: Small, red berries
intro: Growing in the cold of the highlands, these berries are used in the making of juice and wine. They can be eaten, though they do not offer much nourishment. Still, any sustenance is good sustenance when waiting for meatier prey.

title: Highland Berry Pulp
name: Highland Berry Pulp
desc: Red berry pulp
intro: This red-colored pulp, squeezed from highland berries, can be used to make wine.

title: Highland Wine
name: Highland Wine
desc: Wine with a spiced kick
intro: In Vanaheim and in Asgard, it is popular to flavor wine with mulled spices and serve it hot when a fire is available. Such mulled wine heats the body and soul.

title: Honey
name: Honey
desc: The viscous, sweet bounty of bees
intro: Even at the lowest point in the cycle of savagery and civilization, mankind never fails to value honey. The sweet, viscous food substance miraculously defies contagion and rot. It is used in cooking. The very first fermented beverages came from honey. Medicine men and women know to apply honey to rashes, wounds, and burns - to administer it to ease coughs and sore throats. Honey is even employed i

title: Honey Jerky
name: Honey Jerky
desc: Strips of exotic meat dried, salted and drenched in honey
intro: There are those who say drying and salting such fare is a waste of superior meat, but there are also those who want a finer sort of dry ration to reach into their bag for on faraway and lonely trails.

title: Honey Whisky
name: Honey Whisky
desc: A surprisingly smooth drink
intro: A technique out of Arogs uses honey in the processes of fermenting the pulped grapes, producing a drink that is both sweet and medicinal. This is indeed a drink that blesses one's health. This has since been modified by brewers to a more alcoholic drink that also warms the body.

title: Honeybread
name: Honeybread
desc: A loaf of bread that smells of honey
intro: Bread takes on many forms, baked from various mixtures of dough and water. On the climb from savagery, bread tends to come at the dawn of agriculture.

title: Honeyed Eggs
name: Honeyed Eggs
desc: Eggs sizzling hot with a light covering of honey
intro: Eggs make for a fine, storable food, given by nature in their own containers. Cracked open, eggs cook quickly.

title: Honeyed Gruel
name: Honeyed Gruel
desc: It is gruel, but it actually smells good
intro: Sometimes one is able to find a few extra things to throw into the gruel, to make it a more satisfying meal.

title: Honeyed Wine
name: Honeyed Wine
desc: A very sweet wine
intro: A technique out of Arogs uses honey in the processes of fermenting the pulped grapes, producing a wine that is both sweet and medicinal. This is indeed a drink that blesses one's health.

title: Honeyglazed Roast
name: Honeyglazed Roast
desc: Zesty scraps of feral meat, drenched in honey
intro: One of the best uses for strong spice is to improve the flavor of gamey meat, shredded to make up for this chewy toughness. Tavern owners share a proverb: 'A dead rat and a jar of spice will get you a lot further in life than just a dead rat.' This dish heats the pallet.

title: Human Flesh
name: Human Flesh
desc: Flesh torn from other humans
intro: Consuming the flesh of men is a mark of savagery and desperation. Various demonic religious practices encourage ritual consumption while some tribes in the Black Kingdoms devour pieces of their fallen enemies in order to absorb their prowess and courage.

title: Human Heart
name: Human Heart
desc: Stolen from a chest somewhere
intro: One of the most important facets of the worship of Set is ritual sacrifice. With consecrated blades, the worshippers of Set will cut the hearts from their enemies and offer them as sacrifice on the altar of their demonic god.

title: Hunter's Potion
name: Hunter's Potion
desc: This brew grants the drinker greatly improved concussive damage output.
intro: This potion provides the quaffer with a temporary boost to eyesight and greatly improved accuracy - useful for knocking out foes.

title: Hunter's Satchel
name: Hunter's Satchel
desc: A worn satchel dropped by a hunter faithful to Jhebbal Sag
intro: A small collection of valuables held by a hunter faithful to Jhebbal Sag. This necessity to cling to possessions seems to be a vestige of their humanity.

title: Hyperborean Blood
name: Hyperborean Blood
desc: The harvested blood of a Hyperborean that, when used, confers a new character creation option: Light skin.
intro: Since man first stepped from the forest primeval, numerous cultures have upheld the tradition of gaining potency from vanquished foes through the ritual consumption of their blood or body parts.

title: Hyperborean Witch Blood
name: Hyperborean Witch Blood
desc: The harvested blood of a Hyperborean that, when used, confers a new character creation option: Light skin.
intro: Since man first stepped from the forest primeval, numerous cultures have upheld the tradition of gaining potency from vanquished foes through the ritual consumption of their blood or body parts.

title: Ice Tea
name: Ice Tea
desc: A medicinal brew that smells of honey
intro: This brew, a recipe from far away Khitai, revitalizes one's stamina in small measures, and moderately heals the wary and injured over time.

title: Improved Climbing Boots Schematic
name: Improved Climbing Boots Schematic
desc: A crafting schematic
intro: Studying this crafting schematic will unlock the ability to craft new items.

title: Improved Waterskin
name: Improved Waterskin
desc: A sealed leather skin for storing water
intro: Pitch has been used to seal this waterskin, slowing the inevitable leaks and keeping the water level stable. The addition of pitch, however, adds a nasty sulphurous aftertaste to the water.

title: Infused Aloe Extract
name: Infused Aloe Extract
desc: Infused extract of the aloe plant
intro: Stygian traditions of healing hold that the aloe plant contains many desirable properties. In Luxur, the aloe is harvested for use in the temples of Derketo to cleanse blemishes from the skin of the priestesses. It is often used to sooth oozing wounds and those who ingest it claim that they feel a burst of wellbeing. Whether these effects are of the body or the mind is irrelevant - ingesting aloe

title: Infused Wraps
name: Infused Wraps
desc: Bandages used for binding wounds
intro: Wounds require special care, to heal and to avoid infection and putrefaction. Sometimes, upon the battlefield, all one can do is bind a wound with strips of fiber.

title: Jester's Jokebook
name: Jester's Jokebook
desc: A message in a bottle
intro: A long list of jokes, seemingly written by a Court Jester. Reading this will teach you these jokes.

title: Jungle Grog
name: Jungle Grog
desc: A strong, alcoholic beverage
effect: Agility Weapon Damage +15%, Cooling Down, Drunken
intro: Only Vald himself knows what this drink contains but whatever it is it smells of old socks and distilled alcohol.

title: Jungle Rum
name: Jungle Rum
desc: A strong, alcoholic beverage
intro: Only Vald himself knows what this drink contains but whatever it is it smells of old socks and distilled alcohol.

title: Keyring
name: Keyring
desc: A heavy, well-worn ring of blackened iron holding a few keys.
intro: An object that proves worth is in the eye of the beholder. And in some places, this simple ring of blackened iron is worth more than all the gold, silk, and horses in the world. Certainly, worth killing for.

title: Khari Waterskin
name: Khari Waterskin
desc: A sealed leather skin for storing water
intro: Pitch has been used to seal this waterskin, slowing the inevitable leaks and keeping the water level stable. The addition of pitch, however, adds a nasty sulphurous aftertaste to the water.

title: Language Dictionary (Ancient Stygian)

title: Lasting Feast
name: Lasting Feast
desc: A heavy and fatty meal
intro: A meal heavy with fat will stay in one's stomach, and keep them well fed for some time.

title: Leather Satchel
name: Leather Satchel
desc: A worn leather satchel dropped by a sorcerer
intro: The satchel is often the sorcerer's most guarded possession, a container of important lore only relinquished when pried from their cold, dead hands. It can contain a Sorcerous Spell page, reagents used for casting, or other relevant sorcery items.

title: Lumpy Soup
name: Lumpy Soup
desc: Chunks of succulent meat floating in a stew
intro: Meat chopped up and cooked in a broth of vegetables makes for a simmering stew that smells both inviting and filling.

title: Mead
name: Mead
desc: Drink made from fermented honey
intro: Many lands and many people claim the discovery of mead, to be the first to learn that the already wondrous foodstuff of the bee could be fermented into something yet more wondrous. The Aesir and Vanir of Nordheim often seal pacts made in Ymir's name with three successive drinks of mead. A sip of this honeyed brew warms the tongue.

title: Meat Strips
name: Meat Strips
desc: Cooked strips of succulent meat
intro: Both the savage and the civilized mouth water when strips of meat sizzle and hiss on the skewer.

title: Meaty Mashup
name: Meaty Mashup
desc: Various meat scraps cooked together
intro: Waste not, want not. When a variety of meat scraps accrue, it is prudent to gather them and cook them all together before they spoil.

title: Mixed Meat Scraps
name: Mixed Meat Scraps
desc: Cooked strips of succulent meat
intro: Waste not, want not. When a variety of meat scraps accrue, it is prudent to gather them and cook them all together before they spoil.

title: Moray Eel
name: Moray Eel
desc: A rare fish
intro: Raw meat is a dangerous temptation for the starving and desperate. Consuming it provides immediate relief from hunger - but at the risk of inheriting any disease or parasite that may have come along for the ride.

title: Mulled Brew
name: Mulled Brew
desc: Hot and smelling of winter spices
intro: This special brew, heated and loaded with mulled spices, heavily warms a soul even on the longest of winter nights.

title: Mushroom Stew
name: Mushroom Stew
desc: A stew floating with mushrooms
intro: A surplus of mushrooms can make a surprisingly hearty stew.

title: Mushroom Tea
name: Mushroom Tea
desc: Shroom tea with a zesty kick
intro: The mystics of jungle-cradled Khitai know of certain fungi to brew in their tea, for the purposes of expanding their consciousness to fathom realms both resplendently bright and dark as the nighted voids.

title: Mystery Meat Soup
name: Mystery Meat Soup
desc: Under the delicious broth is something that was recently...human
intro: A delicacy out of Darfar. The proper way to serve this delicious, hot broth is with a whole human skull in the bowl, slowly revealed with every slurping spoonful.

title: Night-Eye Potion
name: Night-Eye Potion
desc: A potion that gives the ability to see in the dark
intro: Some creatures have perfect vision even in the darkest of environments. Through the power of Jhebbal Sag, this potion confers the benefits of such night vision to the imbiber.

title: Numbing Wraps
name: Numbing Wraps
desc: Bandages used for binding wounds
intro: Wounds require special care, to heal and to avoid infection and putrefaction. Sometimes, upon the battlefield, all one can do is bind a wound with strips of fiber.

title: One Hundred Shades of Pink
name: One Hundred Shades of Pink
desc: A message in a bottle
intro: This note contain extracts from what seems to be an erotic novella called 'One Hundred Shades of Pink', apparently a sequel to another novella. Reading it will teach you how to engage with others before, while, and after bedding them.

title: Ophidian Magi's Cache
name: Ophidian Magi's Cache
desc: Contains various rewards for your efforts.
intro: This package is full of valuable coins and alchemical components - it was a reward for a dangerous request from a vile man.

title: Oyster Flesh
name: Oyster Flesh
desc: Raw flesh harvested from an oyster
intro: This flesh is harvested from an oyster. It is known as a delicacy in many places, and rumored to increase virility.

title: Oyster Omelette
name: Oyster Omelette
desc: Omelette filled with delicious muscles
intro: A tasty combination of food from the land and the sea.

title: Philter of Fire Wall
name: Philter of Fire Wall
desc: This brew grants the drinker the temporary ability to create a Wall of Fire
intro: This potion allows the quaffer to summon molten magma from the planet's core, causing it to erupt from the ground. The heat causes an extreme temperature shift in the immediate area, and the magma burns anyone it touches.

title: Phykos Rum
name: Phykos Rum
desc: Clear, strong drink with an orange tint
intro: The orange phykos, an aquatic plant normally prized for the dyes that can be rendered from it, can also be fermented into a crude sort of rum. Sailors know that phykos rum goes down with a rough burn and leaves the belly warm.

title: Pirate Rotgut
name: Pirate Rotgut
desc: Makes you grow hairs on the hairs that are already on your chest
intro: Also makes you grow hair on your palms, feet and tongue. Not particularly tasty, but it certainly warms you up.

title: Potion of Bestial Memory
name: Potion of Bestial Memory
desc: A potion that resets attribute points
intro: This potion recalls the beast locked inside every person - pushing their ingrained instincts backwards and allowing them to retrain their body in new ways and forms.

title: Potion of Detect Resources
name: Potion of Detect Resources
desc: This brew grants the drinker the temporary ability to Detect Resources.
intro: This potion allows the quaffer to focus on rare resources in the natural world, revealing nearby deposits.

title: Potion of Endowment
name: Potion of Endowment
desc: Bigger is always better no matter what they say
intro: Some tinctures are useful. Others are merely... engorging.

title: Potion of Invisibility
name: Potion of Invisibility
desc: This brew grants the drinker temporary sic|Invisbility.
intro: This potion allows the quaffer to channel the power of illusion to render themselves unable to be seen.

title: Potion of Lightning Storm
name: Potion of Lightning Storm
desc: This brew grants the drinker the temporary ability to call Lightning Storms.
intro: This potion allows the quaffer to harness the primal forces of raw nature by calling forth a lightning storm.

title: Potion of Lost Souls
name: Potion of Lost Souls
desc: Made from strange materials that dropped from the sky
effect: Crippled (30% chance), Drunken, Headache (10% chance), Increased Charisma (20% chance), Poisoned (10% chance), Water Breathing (20% chance), You are feeling tipsy (50% chance)
intro: From the sky, a light will fall

title: Potion of Midnight
name: Potion of Midnight
desc: A potion that allows communication with Jhebbal Sag
intro: Brewed from a combination of sacred herbs and mushrooms, this potion is supposed to facilitate communication directly with Jhebbal Sag. What that means exactly and how it works can only be discovered through experimentation.

title: Potion of Natural Learning
name: Potion of Natural Learning
desc: A potion that resets knowledge points
intro: This potion clears the knowledge of civilization, wiping away learned skills until the imbiber is left with nothing more than a vast potential for learning. They are then free to sculpt their mind in whichever direction they wish.

title: Potion of the Hunt
name: Potion of the Hunt
desc: A potion that allows communication with Jhebbal Sag
intro: Brewed from a combination of sacred herbs and mushrooms, this potion is supposed to facilitate communication directly with Jhebbal Sag. What that means exactly and how it works can only be discovered through experimentation.

title: Prayer to Mitra
name: Prayer to Mitra
desc: A message in a bottle
intro: This note details the rituals and prayers of Mitra worshippers and contains information about the types of sacrifices and incantations to use to appease the deity. Reading the note will teach you some of gestures and movement to this purpose.

title: Prayer to Set
name: Prayer to Set
desc: A message in a bottle
intro: This note details the rituals and prayers of the Setites and contains information about the types of sacrifices and incantations to use to appease the deity. Reading the note will teach you some of gestures and movement to this purpose.

title: Prayer to Yog
name: Prayer to Yog
desc: A message in a bottle
intro: This note details the rituals and prayers of the Yoggites and contains information about the types of sacrifices and incantations to use to appease the deity. Reading the note will teach you some of gestures and movement to this purpose.

title: Precepts of Derketo
name: Precepts of Derketo
desc: A scroll that teaches the precepts of Derketo
intro: This simple document contains all that one needs to become a worshipper of Derketo. The fact that it must be read, however, is a testament to the subtlety of the cult. For it ensures that only those who are intelligent enough to read will naturally join the religion - and those who cannot must be guided by those who can.

title: Prince of the Black shores
name: Prince of the Black shores
desc: A manuscript written by the Archivist himself
intro: This book tells the story of a prince living on the banks of a river that is polluted by tar from a nearby tannery. Nothing about this story feels right but reading it is strangely inspiring nonetheless. If written by another author, it could have been a very good read.

title: Prophecy of the Borne Witch
name: Prophecy of the Borne Witch
desc: A manuscript written by the Archivist himself
intro: This book describes the life of a pregnant mother who believes her child will grow up to become a witch. Nothing about this story feels right but reading it is strangely inspiring nonetheless. If written by another author, it could have been a very good read.

title: Pure Aloe Extract
name: Pure Aloe Extract
desc: Pure extract of the aloe plant
intro: Stygian traditions of healing hold that the aloe plant contains many desirable properties. In Luxur, the aloe is harvested for use in the temples of Derketo to cleanse blemishes from the skin of the priestesses. It is often used to sooth oozing wounds and those who ingest it claim that they feel a burst of wellbeing. Whether these effects are of the body or the mind is irrelevant - ingesting aloe

title: Purified Flesh
name: Purified Flesh
desc: Flesh that has been ritually purified
effect: Favor of Yog, Health +40, Sated, Stamina +14
intro: Devotees of Yog have purified this flesh in the firepits of sacrifice. It can be eaten to gain the favour of Yog.

title: Purified Water
name: Purified Water
desc: Crystal-clear water
intro: Water is necessary for life, yet it is not always pure. One can risk sickness by drinking from a strange water source. Humankind has learned different methods of purifying their water, from charcoal to boiling.

title: Purple Lotus Potion
name: Purple Lotus Potion
desc: A potion of squeezed purple lotus juice
effect: Crippled, Drunken, Follower Damage +12%, Increased Charisma
intro: The purple lotus plant, which grows in the southern swamps of Stygia, is a favorite weapon of sorcerers. The juice of the plant causes a temporary paralysis - a seemingly sorcerous effect that does not require the actual use of sorcery.

title: Putrid Meat
name: Putrid Meat
desc: Whatever this used to be, it is inedible now
intro: Meat which has begun to putrefy has an odor and flavour all of its own.

title: Raw Pork
name: Raw Pork
desc: Raw flesh harvested from a wild boar
intro: Raw meat is a dangerous temptation for the starving and desperate. Consuming it provides immediate relief from hunger - but at the risk of inheriting any disease or parasite that may have come along for the ride.

title: Reptile-Eye
name: Reptile-Eye
desc: The harvested eyes of a reptile that, when used, confers a new character creation option: Green eyes.
intro: Since man first stepped from the forest primeval, numerous cultures have upheld the tradition of gaining potency from vanquished foes through the ritual consumption of their blood or body parts.

title: Resin Wine
name: Resin Wine
desc: A dark wine with a burning bouquet
intro: This wine is made using resin, darkening its color. It leaves the drinker feeling warmed.

title: Rhino Head Soup
name: Rhino Head Soup
desc: Soup from a great beast's head
intro: There is a very specialized school of divination magic that suggests the future can be divined in a broiled rhinoceros head. There are also hunters who swear the powder of a rhino horn will imbue a man with virility. The veracity of these claims is highly suspect. What is known is that a soup, boiled from the head of a rhino, will imbue the eater with greater power to carry a heavy load.

title: Roasted Haunch
name: Roasted Haunch
desc: A cooked haunch of exotic meat
intro: Taken from one of the more unusual beasts of the Exiled Lands, this mouth-watering meat is the height of culinary grace in this savage land.

title: Roasted Mushrooms
name: Roasted Mushrooms
desc: Bowlful of cooked mushrooms
intro: Some mushrooms are poisonous, it is true, but many can be cooked into a culinary delight. Properly prepared, roasted mushrooms are good for the eater's health over time.

title: Rotten Devil's Bonemeal
name: Rotten Devil's Bonemeal
desc: A stinking mass of black matter
intro: Whatever this once belonged to, it is now unrecognizable. Any occult properties it may have once possessed are probably expired.

title: Rough Wraps
name: Rough Wraps
desc: Bandages used for binding wounds
intro: Wounds require special care, to heal and to avoid infection and putrefaction. Sometimes, upon the battlefield, all one can do is bind a wound with strips of fiber.

title: Rum Runner Vald's Secret Recipe
name: Rum Runner Vald's Secret Recipe
desc: Written in a very unsteady hand
intro: This book contains Vald's secret Grog and Rum recipes. Unfortunately, it does not seem to contain the recipe for a hangover cure.

title: Rusted Lockpick
name: Rusted Lockpick
desc: A set of lockpicks, rusted from their time in the Dregs
intro: Nahjef's trusty lockpicks, thoroughly rusted through after so much time spent in the Dregs. Without the spectres distracting you, it should be possible to finish Nahjef's goal and finish picking the final chest in the Dregs. It is highly likely that the picks will break off in the lock.

title: Salted Berries
name: Salted Berries
desc: A small snack both savory and sweet
intro: A common food practice in Turan is to mix salt with certain sweet fruits. This snack, of salted berries, is both tasty and a little better preserved.

title: Salted Exquisite Meat
name: Salted Exquisite Meat
desc: A salted piece of meat with perfect texture
intro: Salted to perfection, this meat will last.

title: Salted Pork
name: Salted Pork
desc: Salt and fat in a succulent combination
intro: A meal heavy with fat will stay in one's stomach, and keep them well fed for some time.

title: Salvaged Building Materials
name: Salvaged Building Materials
desc: A package of salvaged building parts.
intro: Builders in the Exiled Lands have become accustomed to building and rebuilding again as conflict and the natural elements tend to erode structural integrity over time.

title: Samite Satchel
name: Samite Satchel
desc: An embroidered samite satchel dropped by a sorcerer
intro: The satchel is often the sorcerer's most guarded possession, a container of important lore only relinquished when pried from their cold, dead hands. It can contain a Sorcerous Spell page, reagents used for casting, or other relevant sorcery items.

title: Savory Feast
name: Savory Feast
desc: Heaps and heaps of glorious meat
intro: Large game, in quantity, make for a meal that would put an army of bellies glad. Such a meal offers good health to the eater.

title: Savory Fish
name: Savory Fish
desc: Raw flesh harvested from fish
intro: Raw meat is a dangerous temptation for the starving and desperate. Consuming it provides immediate relief from hunger - but at the risk of inheriting any disease or parasite that may have come along for the ride.

title: Savory Fodder
name: Savory Fodder
desc: A strange smelling fodder for pets
intro: Whatever is in this fodder smells unappetizing. However, feeding it to pets seems to change the color of their coats. Nobody seems to know why and nobody seems to have considered that feeding strange food to animals might have unintended effects.

title: Savory Jerky
name: Savory Jerky
desc: Strips of succulent meat dried and salted
intro: Many a hungry soul, when seeing a fine cut of meat from large game, desire to devour it all in one sitting. The wiser sort know when to ration off a bit and salt and dry it for hungrier nights ahead.

title: Savory Shellfish
name: Savory Shellfish
desc: Raw flesh harvested from shellfish
intro: Raw meat is a dangerous temptation for the starving and desperate. Consuming it provides immediate relief from hunger - but at the risk of inheriting any disease or parasite that may have come along for the ride.

title: Savoury Flesh
name: Savoury Flesh
desc: Raw flesh harvested from common wild animals
intro: Raw meat is a dangerous temptation for the starving and desperate. Consuming it provides immediate relief from hunger but at the risk of inheriting any disease or parasite that may have come along for the ride.

name: Scroll (Abysmal Blade)
desc: A note scrawled on flimsy paper
intro: While this schematic shares no characters or syntax with any language of the age, the detailed step-by-step illustrations are intelligible by accomplished crafters.

title: Skull of Yog

desc: A skull that chants the teachings of Yog
intro: This skull has eyes that burn with the eternal fire of Yog. When held to the ear, like a seashell, one can hear the eternal chanting of Yog.

title: Small Scorpion
name: Small Scorpion
desc: A bite sized scorpion snack with extra sting
intro: A hard crunchy shell with a soft, satisfying center. These are considered a delicacy in some cultures.

title: Sorcerous Pet Food

desc: A strange smelling fodder for pets
intro: Whatever is in this fodder smells unappetizing. However, feeding it to pets seems to change the color of their coats. Nobody seems to know why and nobody seems to have considered that feeding strange food to animals might have unintended effects.

title: Soup
name: Soup
desc: A hearty bowl of broth and other bits of food
intro: When one has a fresh bone and water and a few other odds and ends left over, they have enough to make a satisfying soup.

title: Spiced Egg
name: Spiced Egg
desc: Zesty cooked eggs
intro: Eggs can be livened up with the right spices. This dish warms the pallet.

title: Spiced Exquisite Meat
name: Spiced Exquisite Meat
desc: A spiced piece of meat with perfect texture
intro: There are those who like the natural taste of the meat, cooked rare so that one's teeth still draw blood. And there are those who prefer to inundate their meat with all manner of spices. This dish heats the pallet.

title: Spiced Fowl
name: Spiced Fowl
desc: A spiced dish
intro: A dish made from the innards of Shoebills, fried with honey, spices and short fibrous strains from nearby plants. This dish will grant protection against cold climates. It also burns your tongue - ever so slightly.

title: Spiced Haunch
name: Spiced Haunch
desc: A zesty haunch of exotic meat
intro: There are clubs and cliques among the elite nobles of Zingara that pride themselves on devouring exotic fare. The rarest of meals. There are rumors such organizations employ warlocks simply to summon otherworldly horrors, just so the dinner guests may dine on its spectral flesh. Whatever the truth, they do enjoy spicing their meats until they pleasantly heat the pallet.

title: Spiced Oysters
name: Spiced Oysters
desc: Cooked and zesty oysters
intro: Any Zingaran buccaneer will swear to a very specific regimen before a night of passionate romance: to devour a dozen spiced oysters in quick succession. This seafood heats the pallet.

title: Spiced Pork
name: Spiced Pork
desc: Zesty slab of succulent meat
intro: There are those who like the natural taste of the meat, cooked rare so that one's teeth still draw blood. And there are those who prefer to inundate their meat with all manner of spices. This dish heats the pallet.

title: Spiced Slivers
name: Spiced Slivers
desc: Zesty meat wrapped in crocodile skin
intro: It is said that pirates from the Black Coast created this delicacy by wrapping strips of meat in crocodile skin, heavily spicing the concoction, and then cooking it all until it is crackling crisp. This dish heats one's pallet.

title: Spiced Soup
name: Spiced Soup
desc: A zesty soup
intro: Zingarans are known for making a spicy soup that puts a little fire in one's belly, heating the pallet.

title: Spiced Steak
name: Spiced Steak
desc: Zesty slab of succulent meat
intro: There are those who like the natural taste of the meat, cooked rare so that one's teeth still draw blood. And there are those who prefer to inundate their meat with all manner of spices. This dish heats the pallet.

title: Spiced Tea
name: Spiced Tea
desc: A zesty brew
intro: Strong tea, steeped with potent spices, can drastically refresh one's stamina while heating the body and mind. Turanian guards who draw the late shift are said to be quite fond of this drink on cold, desert nights.

title: Spiced and Shredded Roast
name: Spiced and Shredded Roast
desc: Zesty scraps of feral meat
intro: One of the best uses for strong spice is to improve the flavor of gamey meat, shredded to make up for this chewy toughness. Tavern owners share a proverb: 'A dead rat and a jar of spice will get you a lot further in life than just a dead rat.' This dish heats the pallet.

title: Spicy Dried Fish Combo
name: Spicy Dried Fish Combo
desc: Preserved fish flesh
intro: Salting and drying are among man's earliest means of preserving food. This fish combo has been dried and spiced to perfection. Despite this dish being quite spicy, it does not warm you in any notable fashion.

title: Spoiled Gruel
name: Spoiled Gruel
desc: Gruel that has turned green
intro: The only thing more disgusting than gruel, is spoiled gruel. This lumpy mixture of mold and clustered clumps of debris should not be eaten. By anything.

title: Steak and Eggs
name: Steak and Eggs
desc: Slice of meat and sizzling eggs
intro: When one can spare a cut of succulent meat, a breakfast of eggs becomes a heartier meal that makes the heart happy and the belly more than full.

title: Stomach-Sac
name: Stomach-Sac
desc: The harvest digestive tract of a Doel.
intro: This literal bag of guts functions a kind of fleshy, tumescent container that, when used, confers a random number of monstrous body fluids.

title: Stutter Wraps
name: Stutter Wraps
desc: Bandages used for binding wounds
intro: Wounds require special care, to heal and to avoid infection and putrefaction. Sometimes, upon the battlefield, all one can do is bind a wound with strips of fiber.

title: Stygian Infantry Rations
name: Stygian Infantry Rations
desc: A thin, foul-smelling gruel.
intro: A simple, nutrient-dense mixture that can fuel an army. What it lacks in nuanced flavor, it makes up for by being both portable and nourishing.

title: Stygian Liquor
name: Stygian Liquor
desc: Tastes of venom
intro: A dark-colored wine, popular in Stygia, known to ease a throat that has taken in the dust of the desert roads. It cools the tongue more than the average vintage. It contains a venom-gland at the bottom of the bottle - purists say that in order to properly drink this, ones lips must touch the gland.

name: Tablet of Derketo
desc: A clay tablet depicting the mysteries of Derketo
intro: Initiation into the temple of Derketo is difficult both physically and mentally. The extreme demands upon the body as well as the intense focus required strain the body and mind to the point of breaking.

title: Tablet of Power
name: Tablet of Power
desc: This tablet contains the knowledge of the ancients
intro: Combining the fragments into this completed piece has revealed secrets beyond the ages. Reading this tablet will grant you additional knowledge points, even beyond studying the individual fragments.

title: Tainted Fodder
name: Tainted Fodder
desc: A strange smelling fodder for horses
intro: Whatever is in this fodder smells unappetizing. However, feeding it to horses seems to change the color of their coats. Nobody seems to know why and nobody seems to have considered that feeding strange food to animals might have unintended effects.

title: Tapestry of Zath
name: Tapestry of Zath
desc: A spider silk tapestry depicting the teachings of Zath
intro: The priests of Zath speak of the purity of the god. In the holy city of Yezud, it is forbidden to partake of fermented beverages, gambling or fornication.

title: Tears of Gullah
name: Tears of Gullah
desc: A concoction that increases follower damage.
intro: An elixir with origins in the slave marts of Stygia, this potent brew is named after the gorilla god venerated in the Black Kingdoms and so named for its salty, transparent appearance and ability to enhance the destructive capability of those who quaff it.

title: Ten-Sided Die

desc: A die shaped from bones
intro: A favored pass-time by many adventurers is playing dice. With taverns being few and far apart in the Exiled lands, one has to make do with what one can.

title: The Daughter of Ymir
name: The Daughter of Ymir
desc: A manuscript written by the Archivist himself
intro: This book describes the adventures of one of Ymir's daughters, as she learns how to cook food and behead her enemies. It feels familiar, as if the story was stolen from another author and warped, but it is still strangely inspiring. If written by another author, it could have been a very good read.

name: The Mastodont's Tower
desc: A manuscript written by the Archivist himself
intro: This manuscript tells the tale of a tower made out of living elephants and a barbarian that attempts to climb it for no obvious reason. Nothing about this story feels right but reading it is strangely inspiring nonetheless. If written by another author, it could have been a very good read.

title: Thinker's Notes
name: Thinker's Notes
desc: A message in a bottle
intro: A variety of deep thoughts, such as 'What color is blue - really?' and 'Why can't I lick my own elbow?' are scribbled on this note. Reading it will teach you how to think deeply upon important topics and perhaps you will be the one to finally explain the deep mysteries of the world.

title: Time of the Scaled Lizard
name: Time of the Scaled Lizard
desc: A manuscript written by the Archivist himself
intro: This manuscript details the story of a barbarian that gets bitten by a large, scaled lizard and slowly succumbs to its venom. Most of the book is a draw-out study in agony and pain. The story feels... wrong. But it is strangely inspiring when read. If written by another author, it could have been a very good read.

title: Tinker's Notebook
name: Tinker's Notebook
desc: A message in a bottle
intro: This note contains information about various crafting processes. Reading it will teach you how to properly tinker with things without losing a finger or two.

title: Totemic Fodder
name: Totemic Fodder
desc: Fodder that warps animals to Pictish ways
intro: Passed down by the shamans of pictdom from some dim and ancient past, this recipe when fed to certain animals will cause them to grow into idealized totemic animals of the Picts.

title: Trail Jerky
name: Trail Jerky
desc: Strips of exotic meat dried and salted
intro: There are those who say drying and salting such fare is a waste of superior meat, but there are also those who want a finer sort of dry ration to reach into their bag for on faraway and lonely trails.

name: Unappetizing Fish
desc: Raw flesh harvested from small fish
intro: Raw meat is a dangerous temptation for the starving and desperate. Consuming it provides immediate relief from hunger - but at the risk of inheriting any disease or parasite that may have come along for the ride.

title: Unblemished Human Meat
name: Unblemished Human Meat
desc: Carefully harvested, this meat is ritually pure.
intro: This flesh has not known the touch of a blade and is therefore ritually pure in the eyes of the Yog religion.

title: Vehemence Elixir
name: Vehemence Elixir
desc: Ancient desert elixir, drinking causes shivering under the hottest sun and burn the skin on cold winter nights.
intro: Created by mad sorcerers of Stygia this elixir allowed their armies to withstand the cruelest of hazards and would have paved a way to conquest of the northern lands was it not for the Aquilonian armies stopping them during the battle of Styx. All the trails revealing a true nature of magical concoctions ended there and recipe was never found.

title: Venom-Sac
name: Venom-Sac
desc: Toxin gland of a monster that, when used, confers a random number of poisons and venoms.
intro: Professionals and dabblers beware; extreme caution is advised when handling the delicate membrane of the venom-sac lest the poisoner wish to sample his own product.

title: Violet Curative
name: Violet Curative
desc: A brilliant purple potion that cures everything
intro: Extracted from the venom of various poisonous snakes, this violet potion seems to purge the system of all poisons upon use. Commonly used by street performers in Vendhya to shrug off the effects of cobra bites, more fools have died trying to harvest the ingredients for the curative than would have died if the curative did not exist at all. title: War Torn Fodder
name: War Torn Fodder
desc: A strange smelling fodder for pets
intro: Whatever is in this fodder smells unappetizing. However, feeding it to pets seems to change the color of their coats. Nobody seems to know why and nobody seems to have considered that feeding strange food to animals might have unintended effects.

title: Weak Aloe Extract

desc: Bounty of the grape, drink of the gods
intro: The alcoholic beverage made from the grape. Different grapes and different techniques in their fermentation produce different vintages. Wine lightly cools the tongue.

title: Withered Heart
name: Withered Heart
desc: The heart of a worshipper of Hanuman
intro: This heart was ripped from the chest of a loyal worshipper of Hanuman.

title: Wolf-Eye
name: Wolf-Eye
desc: The harvested eyes of a wolf that, when used, confers a new character creation option: Yellow eyes.
intro: Since man first stepped from the forest primeval, numerous cultures have upheld the tradition of gaining potency from vanquished foes through the ritual consumption of their blood or body parts.

title: Yamatai Fodder
name: Yamatai Fodder
desc: Fodder that warps animals to Yamatai ways
intro: Blessed by the spirits of the elements, this recipe when fed to certain animals will cause them to grow into idealized totemic animals of the Yamatai people.

title: Yellow Lotus Potion
name: Yellow Lotus Potion
desc: A potion that causes hallucinations and visions
intro: The yellow lotus is used by sorcerers to provide visions and trances, with a strong hallucinogenic effect. It is said that those who survive the visions are given a deeper insight into the world, able to communicate with the inner world in a way that rewrites their very physique and increases their stamina.

title: Yellow Lotus Soup
name: Yellow Lotus Soup
desc: Soup boiled from that infamous blossom
intro: While the yellow lotus can make a mind forget its past, one may cook it into a soup and boil out this property. So prepared, it becomes a safe and rather mundane meal, despite the mystical mystique surrounding the flower.

title: Zathite Bag
name: Zathite Bag
desc: A bag woven of spider silk
intro: Woven of the finest strands of spider silk, this bag bears the markings of Zath. Usually carried by a devotee of the religion, it could contain anything from spider eggs to temple valuables. The only way to find out, is to open it.
